name: Alchemist's Fire
description: A sealed clay flask, warm to hold, that must never be opened.
body:
## What it is

Hurl it up to 20 feet as an action, a ranged attack with an improvised weapon. Whatever it hits catches fire and takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns, until someone spends an action on a DC 10 Dexterity check to beat the flames out.
